def transform3(grid):
    g=[list(r) for r in grid]
    comps=_comps(g)
    big=max(comps,key=lambda t:len(t[1]))
    rest=[(i,(c,ce)) for i,(c,ce) in enumerate(comps) if ce is not big[1]]
    ccnt=Counter(c for i,(c,ce) in rest)
    singles=[(i,c,ce) for i,(c,ce) in rest if ccnt[c]==1]
    cnt=Counter(sig(ce) for _,ce in comps)
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i,(col,cells) in enumerate(comps):
        if ce_is_big:= (cells is big[1]): continue
        if cnt[sig(cells)]!=2: continue
        partner=[(j,c2,ce2) for j,c2,ce2 in singles+[(k,cc,ce3) for k,(cc,ce3) in rest] if j!=i and k!=i and sig(ce3)==sig(cells)]
        pj={p[0] for p in partner}
        best=None
        for j,tc,te in singles:
            if j==i or j in pj: continue
            dd=mind(te,cells)
            if dd<=2 and (best is None or dd<best[0]): best=(dd,tc)
        if best:
            pm=[(j,c2,ce2) for j,(c2,ce2) in rest if j!=i and sig(ce2)==sig(cells)][0]
            for y,x in pm[2]: out[y][x]=best[1]
    return out

import json,os

src='''from collections import Counter

def _comps(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
    for y in range(H):
        for x in range(W):
            if (y,x) in seen: continue
            col=g[y][x]; stk=[(y,x)]; ce=[]; seen.add((y,x))
            while stk:
                a,b=stk.pop(); ce.append((a,b))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    na,nb=a+dy,b+dx
                    if 0<=na<H and 0<=nb<W and (na,nb) not in seen and g[na][nb]==col:
                        seen.add((na,nb)); stk.append((na,nb))
            out.append((col,ce))
    return out

def _sig(cells):
    ys=[y for y,_ in cells]; xs=[x for _,x in cells]
    return tuple(sorted((y-min(ys),x-min(xs)) for y,x in cells))

def _mind(a,b):
    return min(abs(y1-y2)+abs(x1-x2) for y1,x1 in a for y2,x2 in b)

def transform(grid):
    g=[list(r) for r in grid]
    comps=_comps(g)
    big=max(comps,key=lambda t:len(t[1]))
    rest=[(i,(c,ce)) for i,(c,ce) in enumerate(comps) if ce is not big[1]]
    ccnt=Counter(c for i,(c,ce) in rest)
    singles=[(i,c,ce) for i,(c,ce) in rest if ccnt[c]==1]
    cnt=Counter(_sig(ce) for _,ce in comps)
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i,(col,cells) in rest:
        if cnt[_sig(cells)]!=2: continue
        partner=[(j,ce2) for j,(c2,ce2) in rest if j!=i and _sig(ce2)==_sig(cells)]
        if not partner: continue
        pj=partner[0][0]; pce=partner[0][1]
        best=None
        for j,tc,te in singles:
            if j in (i,pj): continue
            dd=_mind(te,cells)
            if dd<=2 and (best is None or dd<best[0]): best=(dd,tc)
        if best:
            for y,x in pce: out[y][x]=best[1]
    return out
'''
